purpose: One orchestrator for up to 100 independent assurance sets with barriered execution, evidence binding, bounded recovery, and authority firewall.
constitutional_rules: RUNNING is never PASS or FAIL.
No wave advances until every canonical required control reaches a terminal state.
Evidence must bind to iteration, wave, source SHA, command, and result.
Stale or mismatched evidence is rejected and creates HOLD.
Autobot may repair and re-verify but may not self-authorize merge.
PowerShell is an execution backend; authority remains bounded by policy.
The assurance set registry is canonical for set identity, lifecycle, and wave placement.
The execution set registry is a derived projection and may not invent, rename, move, or activate a canonical set.
Every canonical IMPLEMENTED set is required; a missing execution projection creates HOLD.
Global runtime, scope, changed-file, and risk limits are enforced at execution time.
Master aggregation does not self-certify independent review.
